description: Real, valid, semantic HTML from scratch: document structure, text, links, images, lists, tables, forms, and semantic regions, ending in a capstone page.
levelTitle: Level 1: Core Web Standards & Styling Architecture

lessons.title: HTML: The Structure of the Web
lessons.description: Write your first HTML, understand what elements and nesting are, and build a tiny page using meaningful structure instead of visual guesswork.
lessons.topicTitle: Html The Structure Of The Web
lessons.originalIntent: Write your first HTML, understand what elements and nesting are, and build a tiny page using meaningful structure instead of visual guesswork.

lessons.title: Elements, Tags, and Attributes
lessons.description: Learn how HTML elements are written, how opening and closing tags create structure, and how attributes provide additional information.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how HTML elements are written, how opening and closing tags create structure, and how attributes provide additional information.

lessons.title: Headings, Paragraphs, and Text
lessons.description: Practice using HTML headings and paragraphs to create a clear document structure that communicates hierarchy to both people and the browser.
lessons.originalIntent: Practice using HTML headings and paragraphs to create a clear document structure that communicates hierarchy to both people and the browser.

lessons.title: Links, Images, and Paths
lessons.description: Practice using anchors and images correctly, understand how href and src point to resources, and learn how relative and absolute paths are resolved by the browser.
lessons.originalIntent: Practice using anchors and images correctly, understand how href and src point to resources, and learn how relative and absolute paths are resolved by the browser.

lessons.title: Lists and Tables
lessons.description: Practice using HTML lists to represent ordered or unordered collections and tables to represent genuine tabular data.
lessons.originalIntent: Practice using HTML lists to represent ordered or unordered collections and tables to represent genuine tabular data.

lessons.title: Forms and User Input
lessons.description: Build forms that collect user input using labels, inputs, and a submit action, and learn why associating labels with controls is essential for usable HTML.
lessons.originalIntent: Build forms that collect user input using labels, inputs, and a submit action, and learn why associating labels with controls is essential for usable HTML.

lessons.title: Semantic HTML
lessons.description: Learn how semantic HTML elements communicate the role of page regions and content, then refactor generic markup into meaningful structure that is easier to navigate, maintain, and understand.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how semantic HTML elements communicate the role of page regions and content, then refactor generic markup into meaningful structure that is easier to navigate, maintain, and understand.

lessons.title: HTML Challenge: Build a Real Page
lessons.description: Bring the HTML module together by building a complete page that uses headings, text, links, images, lists, forms, and semantic structure in one coherent document.
lessons.topicTitle: Html Challenge Build A Real Page
lessons.originalIntent: Bring the HTML module together by building a complete page that uses headings, text, links, images, lists, forms, and semantic structure in one coherent document.
